assertion.statement: For the specified LP04 petal quotient and polynomial core/petal coefficient family, choose the initial test with an integral extension of its character to G_m. A fixed rational taut nilmanifold with multidegree (1,m) and one of finitely many global smooth unit-vector tests represents this family exactly, up to fixed zero padding, on a positive-density parameter subfamily. The conditional LP04 comparison survives this choice.
assertion.objects: G, Gamma, P, Lambda, T, eta; eta_bar; K=G semidirect P; V=R^ell; H=V semidirect K; Delta; H_(a,j); polynomial O(h,n); local W, global W0, and F_j.
assertion.hypotheses: m>=1,1<=R<=m; the exact weighted monomial quotient and integral Hall facts of LP04; P abelian with unique-petal summands and the LP04 real/integer action identities; eta integral on T; fixed geometry; g0 and g1 polynomial in the ordinary weight filtration. LP04 comparison is consumed only when all its additional hypotheses hold.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such fixed configuration; all real alpha and polynomial coefficients; every finite nonempty S subset Z; all integers h,n; all real group points and all corresponding limit points after natural extension.
assertion.parameter_range: ell>=0 finite, arbitrary alpha in R^ell, m>=1 and 1<=R<=m, all N; no small-coefficient or near-zero-fractional-part restriction.
assertion.uniformity: Manifold, lattice, finite list of test functions, dimensions and Lipschitz bounds depend on fixed quotient data and character, not N, alpha, h or orbit coefficients.
assertion.constants: Nilpotency class at most m+1; density loss at most a factor J from a fixed finite cover depending only on ell; squared vector norm exactly 1; no effective numerical Lipschitz estimate asserted.
assertion.normalizations: Right lattice quotients; right-action semidirect multiplication; braces in [-1/2,1/2)^ell; e(t)=exp(2 pi i t); coordinatewise N^2 downset filtration; binomial polynomial coefficients.
assertion.exceptional_cases: M_0 is not invertible; rho_t is invertible with inverse rho_-t. Trivial top groups, zero characters and ell=0 are allowed. An arbitrary old T-equivariant test need not work. R>1 gives only lower degree-rank comparison.
assertion.limit_order: Fix groups, character, charts, tests and cover first. Choose a dense subfamily by finite pigeonhole and then pass to full internal domains. Rank iteration and the analytic hypotheses remain separate.

nine_obligations.available_to_needed_comparison: The theorem lists the exact monomial quotient, lattice, petal actions, integral character and polynomial-family hypotheses. LP04 comparison retains all of its own additional premises.
Both semidirect multiplications, inverses, signs, Lie algebra and nilpotency class are explicit. Sections 2 and 6 construct the stronger character and actual global unit tests.
The full N^2 filtration, including H00, H10, all higher/trivial indices and full G_j in H0j, is given and checked. Section 5 defines the source filtration.
The orbit reduction is exact right multiplication by (-z_h,1,1) in Delta. The local chart and zero-padded equality are proved in Section 6.
The subgroup and inverse properties, discreteness, explicit cocompactness and every filtered lattice intersection are proved. Section 6 verifies the central quotient lattice and torus bundle.
A predetermined finite cover with positive margins bounds density loss and test derivatives independently of all orbit coefficients and N. Character-uniform effective estimates are not claimed.
The original eta is first extended integrally to G_m. All-point equivariance on P_m then holds on the full ultrapower, not merely standard points.
Exact unit-norm component recovery joins to the conditional LP04 lower-degree-rank comparison; R>1 rank iteration, correlation and other Theorem 7.1 inputs remain open.
The bounded occurrence audit records nine issues and specific current/historical dispositions. It does not certify uninspected claims or the whole assembly.
